title: Qwen3.8-27B Hugging Face resources were recorded
summary: On 2026-08-14, this development line recorded a Hugging Face model repository for Qwen3.8-27B, a listing filtered for quantized models based on it, and a Hugging Face Space bearing the same model name. Together, these dated links establish a public reference point for the model and related downstream resources. They do not by themselves establish a release announcement, technical specifications, or the Space's functionality.
